Built to go beyond the obvious, challenge the consensus, and surface what’s actually coming before it arrives. Original ideas, rigorously tested, and designed to drive real-world impact. For decades, our cross-disciplinary research has shaped the questions at the top of the CEO agenda. Drawing on a global network of academics, scientists, and institutional partners, we combine deep intellectual rigor with BCG’s unmatched view of business in practice. We don’t just study the forces reshaping business, technology, economics, and geopolitics so leaders can act with clarity and conviction. We form an independent view on what they mean, and we’re willing to say so, even when it cuts against the grain. The result is insight that doesn’t just inform leaders. It changes how they act. Learn More BCG Institute’s Insight Themes Strategy Geopolitics Tech and AI Climate and Energy Transition Macroeconomics Human Futures Strategy Geopolitics Tech and AI Climate and Energy Transition Macroeconomics Human Futures Strategy Led by Ulrich Pidun, the team helps identify and develop ideas that will change the way leaders think about strategy. They also research topics like resilience and navigating uncertainty, imagination and innovation, and corporate vitality. Geopolitics Led by Nikolaus Lang, this team explores the evolution of the global landscape in an increasingly multipolar world, driven by technological, demographic, economic, and cultural changes. Their research focuses on how uncertainties, opportunities, and strategic shifts impact the sources of competitive advantage for businesses. Tech and AI Led by Greg Emerson, this team helps leaders navigate the rapidly changing technology landscape. Some of the team’s current research themes include topics such as AI competitiveness, deep tech, and AI and society. Climate and Energy Transition Led by Maurice Berns, this team explores sustainability as a source of competitive advantage and the hidden dynamics of the energy and sustainability transition. Macroeconomics Led by Philipp Carlsson-Szlezak, this team publishes economics commentary in external publications and technical research for BCG’s clients. The team also translates global macro for senior executives and investors in all industries and all geographies. Human Futures Led by Sagar Goel, this team develops pioneering thought leadership to shape a human-centered future of work. The team’s current research themes include topics such as the workforce of the future, skills and leadership in the age of AI, human-AI symbiosis, and radical employee centricity.
